summary: σ = −πI. Requires global constants R and T in `<Globals>`. `phir` and `cr` may take a loadcurve via `lc` attribute to model growth. To make initial config stress-free, let cr = (1−φs_r) ce initially.
manual_ref: FEBio 4.x User Manual §4.1.4.3 Cell Growth, p205（4.13）

phir.meaning: intracellular solid volume fraction in reference (strain-free) configuration, φs_r

cr.meaning: intracellular molar content of membrane-impermeant solute (moles per volume of the cell in the reference configuration), cr

example.source: pyfebio 默认值不足以构造出该材料，需人工补全必要参数后给出示例。
